builtins.name: print
builtins.doc: Writes the values to the log (and the editor's console and status bar), separated by spaces.

builtins.name: str
builtins.doc: The value as text.

builtins.name: num
builtins.doc: The number in a string, or nil if it isn't one.

builtins.name: floor
builtins.doc: Rounds down.

builtins.name: ceil
builtins.doc: Rounds up.

builtins.name: round
builtins.doc: Rounds to the nearest whole number.

builtins.name: abs
builtins.doc: The value without its sign.

builtins.name: sqrt
builtins.doc: Square root (x must not be negative).

builtins.name: sin
builtins.doc: Sine of an angle in degrees.

builtins.name: cos
builtins.doc: Cosine of an angle in degrees.

builtins.name: atan2
builtins.doc: The angle of (x, y), in degrees.

builtins.name: pow
builtins.doc: x to the power y.

builtins.name: min
builtins.doc: The smallest of the numbers.

builtins.name: max
builtins.doc: The largest of the numbers.

builtins.name: clamp
builtins.doc: v kept between lo and hi.

builtins.name: lerp
builtins.doc: From a (t = 0) to b (t = 1). Numbers, vec2s or vec3s.

builtins.name: random
builtins.doc: A random number: 0..1, 0..n or a..b. Deterministic per world.

builtins.name: vec2
builtins.doc: A 2D vector. Has .x, .y and .length; + - with vec2s, * / by numbers.

builtins.name: length
builtins.doc: How long a vec2 or vec3 is.

builtins.name: normalize
builtins.doc: v scaled to length 1 (or zero). A vec2 or a vec3.

builtins.name: dot
builtins.doc: The dot product of two vec2s (or two vec3s).

builtins.name: distance
builtins.doc: The distance between two points (vec2s, or vec3s).

builtins.name: angle
builtins.doc: The direction of a vec2, in degrees (0 = right, 90 = down).

builtins.name: from_angle
builtins.doc: A vec2 pointing that way.

builtins.name: rgb
builtins.doc: A colour ("#rrggbbaa") for colour fields, e.g. self.Shape.color = rgb(255, 0, 0).

builtins.name: len
builtins.doc: How many items (or characters).

builtins.name: push
builtins.doc: Adds value at the end; returns the list.

builtins.name: pop
builtins.doc: Removes and returns the last item.

builtins.name: remove
builtins.doc: Removes and returns the item at index (-1 = the last).

builtins.name: contains
builtins.doc: Whether the list holds the value.

builtins.name: range
builtins.doc: A list of numbers: 0..n-1, or a up to (not including) b.

builtins.name: key_down
builtins.doc: Whether a key is held: "left", "a", "space", "shift", "F1"...

builtins.name: key_pressed
builtins.doc: Whether a key went down this frame.

builtins.name: key_released
builtins.doc: Whether a key came up this frame.

builtins.name: mouse_down
builtins.doc: Whether a mouse button is held (0 left, 1 right, 2 middle).

builtins.name: mouse_pressed
builtins.doc: Whether a mouse button went down this frame.

builtins.name: mouse_position
builtins.doc: Where the mouse is, in game pixels.

builtins.name: button_down
builtins.doc: Whether a gamepad button is held, on that pad (0 to 3) or any: a b x y, lb rb, lt rt (the triggers), back start guide, ls rs (the sticks pressed in), up down left right (the d-pad); PlayStation names ("cross", "circle"...) and "l1", "r2", "select", "menu" work too. Every pad has the same Xbox-style layout.

builtins.name: button_pressed
builtins.doc: Whether a gamepad button went down this step, on that pad or any (names as button_down()).

builtins.name: button_released
builtins.doc: Whether a gamepad button came up this step, on that pad or any (names as button_down()).

builtins.name: axis
builtins.doc: A stick's "left_x", "left_y", "right_x", "right_y" (-1 to 1; +y is down) or a trigger's "lt", "rt" (0 to 1), with the dead zone taken off. Without a pad, the one pushed furthest.

builtins.name: stick
builtins.doc: The "left" or "right" stick as a vec2, each part -1 to 1 (+y is down), with the dead zone taken off.

builtins.name: gamepad_connected
builtins.doc: Whether that gamepad (0 to 3) is plugged in, or (without one) any.

builtins.name: gamepad_count
builtins.doc: How many gamepads are plugged in.

builtins.name: gamepad_name
builtins.doc: What a gamepad calls itself ("" if there is none); without a pad, the first one plugged in.

builtins.name: last_button
builtins.doc: The name of a gamepad button pressed this step on any pad ("" if none), as button_down() takes it: for letting players choose their buttons.

builtins.name: last_input
builtins.doc: What the player touched last: "keyboard", "mouse", "gamepad" or "touch" (the touch screen and its on-screen controls; "" before anything), kept from scene to scene: for showing a key's name or a button's in prompts.

builtins.name: rumble
builtins.doc: Shakes a gamepad (or every one): strength 0 to 1, for that long; 0 stops it. True if a pad could.

builtins.name: touch_controls_shown
builtins.doc: Whether the on-screen touch controls are showing (they appear once the screen is touched; the project's touch_controls setting lists them).

builtins.name: show_touch_controls
builtins.doc: Hides the on-screen touch controls for now (false: a cutscene, a menu taken with taps), or shows them again (true).

builtins.name: set_touch_controls
builtins.doc: Changes the on-screen touch controls: "stick, a, b, start", or with keys and labels "stick=arrows, a=space:JUMP" ("" removes them).

builtins.name: time
builtins.doc: Seconds since the game started.

builtins.name: find
builtins.doc: The first entity with this name, or nil.

builtins.name: find_all
builtins.doc: A list of every entity with this name.

builtins.name: find_tagged
builtins.doc: Every entity with the tag (or with all of the tags given: `find_tagged("enemy", "flying")`), as a list. Tags are set in the inspector (the Tags component) or with add_tag().

builtins.name: first_tagged
builtins.doc: The first entity with the tag (or with all of the tags given), or nil.

builtins.name: has_tag
builtins.doc: Whether the entity has the tag (exactly: case counts).

builtins.name: add_tag
builtins.doc: Gives the entity a tag (it gets a Tags component if it has none). A tag is up to 31 letters, digits and _-.:/ characters.

builtins.name: remove_tag
builtins.doc: Takes a tag off the entity; true if it had it.

builtins.name: tags
builtins.doc: The entity's tags, as a list of strings.

builtins.name: destroy
builtins.doc: Removes the entity (and its children) at the end of the step.

builtins.name: spawn
builtins.doc: Adds a copy of a scene file's entities and returns the first. With a parent, position is in its space.

builtins.name: children
builtins.doc: The entity's direct children, as a list.

builtins.name: child
builtins.doc: The direct child with that name, or nil.

builtins.name: has
builtins.doc: Whether the entity has the component, e.g. has(other, "RigidBody").

builtins.name: add
builtins.doc: Adds a component (with its defaults) and returns it.

builtins.name: remove_component
builtins.doc: Removes a component.

builtins.name: apply_force
builtins.doc: Pushes a RigidBody (or RigidBody3D, with vec3s) over the next step. With a world point, also spins it.

builtins.name: apply_impulse
builtins.doc: Changes a RigidBody's velocity at once (vec3s for a RigidBody3D).

builtins.name: raycast
builtins.doc: The first solid collider on the line: [entity, point, normal], or nil. With vec3s: 3D colliders. mask: the collision layers to look at (bits; -1 all).

builtins.name: entity_at
builtins.doc: The collider at a world point (a vec3: a 3D collider), or nil. mask: the collision layers to look at (bits; -1 all).

builtins.name: play_sound
builtins.doc: Plays a WAV file from the project on the sfx bus. pitch is the playback rate (2 = an octave up), pan -1 (left) to 1 (right). Returns the voice, for stop_sound() and the rest (0 if none was free).

builtins.name: send
builtins.doc: Calls a function in another entity's script if it has one; nil otherwise.

builtins.name: load_scene
builtins.doc: Ends this scene and starts the scene file at `path` (after this step). In the editor's Play, the scene is swapped in until Stop.

builtins.name: quit
builtins.doc: Ends the game. In the editor, it stops playing.

builtins.name: tile_at
builtins.doc: The character in the Tilemap cell under a world point ("" outside the map).

builtins.name: set_tile
builtins.doc: Changes the Tilemap cell under a world point; false outside the map.

builtins.name: tile_solid
builtins.doc: Is the Tilemap cell under a world point one of the map's solid characters? (false outside the map)

builtins.name: tile_center
builtins.doc: The world position of the centre of the Tilemap cell under a point.

builtins.name: substr
builtins.doc: Part of a string: count characters from start (a negative start counts from the end).

builtins.name: save_data
builtins.doc: Keeps a value (a number, string, true/false, nil, vec2, or a list of those) for the next time the game runs, as name.txt in the game's folder for saved data. Returns false if it couldn't be written.

builtins.name: load_data
builtins.doc: The value save_data() kept under this name, or the default if there is none (or the file is damaged).

builtins.name: has_data
builtins.doc: Is there saved data by this name?

builtins.name: delete_data
builtins.doc: Forgets the saved data by this name. True if it's gone (or never was).

builtins.name: data_names
builtins.doc: The names of all the game's saved data, in order.

builtins.name: last_key
builtins.doc: The name of a key pressed this step ("" if none), as key_down() takes it: for letting players choose their keys.

builtins.name: set_volume
builtins.doc: Sets a mix bus's volume: "master", "sfx", "music", "ui" or "ambient"; 0 is silent, 1 full (up to 2). A Sound component's bus field says which it plays on; play_sound() plays on sfx.

builtins.name: volume
builtins.doc: A mix bus's volume ("master", "sfx", "music", "ui" or "ambient").

builtins.name: draw_rect
builtins.doc: Inside draw(): a rectangle, from its top-left corner. filled false draws its outline.

builtins.name: draw_line
builtins.doc: Inside draw(): a line.

builtins.name: draw_circle
builtins.doc: Inside draw(): a circle (filled false: its outline).

builtins.name: draw_text
builtins.doc: Inside draw(): text in the built-in 8x8 font, from its top-left corner.

builtins.name: draw_image
builtins.signature: draw_image(path, centre, frame = 0, frame_size = vec2(0, 0), flip_x = false)
builtins.doc: Inside draw(): an image (or one frame of a sprite sheet), centred on a point.

builtins.name: text_size
builtins.doc: How much room text takes (width, height) in the built-in font, as draw_text() and Labels draw it.

builtins.name: camera
builtins.doc: The Camera the game draws with (the first that is current), or nil.

builtins.name: shake_camera
builtins.doc: Shakes the current camera by up to `strength` pixels, fading over `seconds`.

builtins.name: snap_camera
builtins.doc: Puts the current camera straight where it is heading (no smoothing): after moving to a new room, say.

builtins.name: screen_to_world
builtins.doc: A point on the screen (game pixels) as a point in the world, through the current camera.

builtins.name: world_to_screen
builtins.doc: A point in the world as a point on the screen (game pixels), through the current camera. With a vec3: where a 3D point appears, through the scene's Camera3D (behind the camera, or with none: vec2(-100000, -100000)).

builtins.name: play_animation
builtins.doc: Plays frames of its Sprite sheet ("0-3", "4,5,6") with an Animation component (added if needed), from the first frame unless they are playing already. On a 3D model (a Mesh with a .gltf/.glb file): play_animation(e, clip[, speed[, loop]]) plays that animation through its Animator, crossfading from the last.

builtins.name: stop_sound
builtins.doc: Stops a sound play_sound() started (fading out over a few milliseconds).

builtins.name: sound_playing
builtins.doc: Is that sound still playing?

builtins.name: set_sound_volume
builtins.doc: Changes a playing sound's volume.

builtins.name: set_sound_pitch
builtins.doc: Changes a playing sound's pitch (its playback rate: 2 is an octave up).

builtins.name: set_sound_pan
builtins.doc: Moves a playing sound from left (-1) to right (1).

builtins.name: pause_sound
builtins.doc: Pauses a playing sound (true) or carries it on (false).

builtins.name: stop_sounds
builtins.doc: Stops every sound playing, or every one on a bus ("sfx", "music", "ui", "ambient").

builtins.name: sound_length
builtins.doc: How long a sound file is, in seconds.

builtins.name: play_music
builtins.doc: Loops a track on the music bus, fading in over `fade` seconds while the one before fades out. It keeps playing through load_scene(). The same track again only changes its volume.

builtins.name: stop_music
builtins.doc: Stops the music play_music() started, fading out over `fade` seconds.

builtins.name: music
builtins.doc: The track play_music() is playing ("" for none).

builtins.name: play_tone
builtins.doc: Plays a tone made on the spot - "sine", "square", "triangle", "saw" or "noise" - for blips with no sound file. Returns the voice.

builtins.name: broadcast
builtins.doc: Calls the function in every script of the scene that has it, and returns how many did. (C code hears it on the message bus as "script.<function>".)

builtins.name: push_scene
builtins.doc: Puts a scene on top of this one (a pause menu, a map). transparent: this one still shows under it; update_below: this one keeps running.

builtins.name: pop_scene
builtins.doc: Takes the top scene off the stack (after this step); the one under it carries on, and its scripts' on_resume() runs.

builtins.name: set_global
builtins.doc: Keeps a value while the game runs, across load_scene() and push_scene(): a number, string, true/false, nil, vec2 or list of these.

builtins.name: global
builtins.doc: A value set_global() kept, or the default.

builtins.name: has_global
builtins.doc: Did set_global() keep a value by that name?

builtins.name: delete_global
builtins.doc: Forgets a global (true if there was one).

builtins.name: set_fullscreen
builtins.doc: Fills the screen with the game (true) or goes back to a window.

builtins.name: fullscreen
builtins.doc: Is the game filling the screen?

builtins.name: set_window_title
builtins.doc: The window's title (the page's, on the web).

builtins.name: show_cursor
builtins.doc: Shows or hides the mouse pointer over the game.

builtins.name: screen_size
builtins.doc: The game's screen, in game pixels (its width and height).

builtins.name: mouse_released
builtins.doc: Was the mouse button let go this step? 0 left, 1 right, 2 middle.

builtins.name: mouse_wheel
builtins.doc: How far the wheel turned since the last frame (+y towards the player), once a frame.

builtins.name: mouse_motion
builtins.doc: How far the mouse moved since the last frame, in game pixels (once a frame). Keeps coming while the mouse is locked, for mouse-look.

builtins.name: lock_mouse
builtins.doc: Capture the mouse for mouse-look: the pointer is hidden and held in the window, and mouse_motion() reports its movement. Let go while the window is in the background; on the web, it waits for the next click.

builtins.name: mouse_locked
builtins.doc: Whether the game has asked for the mouse to be locked (lock_mouse).

builtins.name: text_typed
builtins.doc: The characters typed since the last frame (once a frame): for entering names.

builtins.name: touches
builtins.doc: Where each finger on the screen is (game pixels), leaving out those on the on-screen controls.

builtins.name: bind
builtins.doc: Adds inputs to a named action (up to 6): a key's name ("space"), "mouse:0", "pad:a", or "pad:left_x-" (a stick pushed that way). "shift", "ctrl" and "alt" mean either side; "leftshift" one side.

builtins.name: unbind
builtins.doc: Takes every input off an action.

builtins.name: action_down
builtins.doc: Is any of the action's inputs held?

builtins.name: action_pressed
builtins.doc: Did one of the action's inputs go down this step? (Once per press, like key_pressed().)

builtins.name: action_released
builtins.doc: Was the action let go this step?

builtins.name: action_axis
builtins.doc: -1, 0 or 1 from two actions (left and right, say).

builtins.name: gravity
builtins.doc: The physics gravity in effect (pixels / second^2).

builtins.name: set_gravity
builtins.doc: Sets the PhysicsWorld's gravity (adding one to this entity if the scene has none).

builtins.name: tile_cell
builtins.doc: The column and row of the cell under a world point (outside the map too).

builtins.name: tile_get
builtins.doc: The character in a cell, or "" outside the map.

builtins.name: tile_put
builtins.doc: Changes a cell (false outside the map).

builtins.name: tile_cell_center
builtins.doc: The world position of the middle of a cell.

builtins.name: tile_box_solid
builtins.doc: Does a box (world centre, full size) overlap any of the map's solid cells? Edges only touching don't count: for walls and floors in scripted movement.

builtins.name: random_seed
builtins.doc: Starts random() from a seed: the same seed gives the same numbers.

builtins.name: clipboard
builtins.doc: The text on the clipboard.

builtins.name: set_clipboard
builtins.doc: Puts text on the clipboard.

builtins.name: fps
builtins.doc: Frames drawn per second, lately.

builtins.name: frame_count
builtins.doc: How many frames the game has run.

builtins.name: log_warning
builtins.doc: Writes a warning to the log (and the editor's console).

builtins.name: log_error
builtins.doc: Writes an error to the log (and the editor's console).

builtins.name: open_url
builtins.doc: Opens a web address in the browser (or a file in its program).

builtins.name: image_size
builtins.doc: An image file's width and height.

builtins.name: vec3
builtins.doc: A 3D vector. Has .x, .y, .z and .length; + - with vec3s, * / by numbers.

builtins.name: cross
builtins.doc: The cross product of two vec3s: at right angles to both.

builtins.name: apply_torque
builtins.doc: Spins a RigidBody3D over the next step (a vec3: about x, y and z).

builtins.name: overlap_sphere
builtins.doc: Every 3D collider (triggers too) touching a sphere, as a list of entities.

builtins.name: look_at
builtins.doc: Turns a 3D entity to face a point (its forward, -z, towards it; +y kept up).

builtins.name: screen_ray
builtins.doc: [origin, direction] (two vec3s): the line through a screen point into the 3D scene, for clicking on 3D things.

builtins.name: move_and_slide
builtins.doc: Moves a 3D entity by velocity * dt, sliding along what it bumps into; returns the velocity with the parts that went into things taken out (keep it for the next frame). For characters: a capsule Collider3D with no dynamic RigidBody3D.

builtins.name: is_on_floor
builtins.doc: True if the last move_and_slide() of this entity ended against the ground.

builtins.name: is_on_wall
builtins.doc: True if the last move_and_slide() of this entity ended against a wall.

builtins.name: is_on_ceiling
builtins.doc: True if the last move_and_slide() of this entity ended against a ceiling.

builtins.name: emit
builtins.doc: Gives off count particles at once from an entity's Particles (without a count: its burst).

builtins.name: particle_count
builtins.doc: How many of an entity's particles are alive.

builtins.name: tween
builtins.signature: tween(entity, property, target, seconds, ease, delay)
builtins.doc: Eases a property from where it is to target over seconds: "position", "x", "rotation", "scale", "Shape.color", a script variable... Numbers, vec2s, vec3s and colours. Ease: linear (default), ease_in, ease_out, ease_in_out, cubic_in/out/in_out, sine_in/out/in_out, back_in, back_out, elastic_out, bounce_out. With a delay it starts later, from wherever the property is then. Returns its id.

builtins.name: tween_repeat
builtins.doc: Plays a tween again times more times (-1: for ever); yoyo goes back and forth.

builtins.name: tween_then
builtins.doc: Calls one of this script's functions (taking no arguments) when the tween ends.

builtins.name: stop_tween
builtins.doc: Stops a tween, or every tween of an entity; what it changed stays where it got to.

builtins.name: is_tweening
builtins.doc: True while that tween runs; or while any (or that property's) tween of an entity runs.

builtins.name: ease
builtins.doc: An easing curve at t (0 to 1), as tween() uses: ease("ease_out", 0.5).

builtins.name: stop_animation
builtins.doc: Holds an entity's animation where it is (a 3D model's Animator, or a 2D Animation).

builtins.name: animation_clips
builtins.doc: The names of the animations in an entity's 3D model (a .gltf / .glb).

builtins.name: find_with
builtins.doc: Every entity with that component (one of the engine's, or the game's own): `for e in find_with("Health") { ... }`.

properties.name: position
properties.doc: Transform.position, in the parent's space (a vec3 in @3d files: Transform3D.position)

properties.name: rotation
properties.doc: Transform.rotation (degrees, clockwise), relative to the parent. In @3d files a vec3: Transform3D.rotation (pitch, yaw, roll in degrees)

properties.name: scale
properties.doc: Transform.scale (set a number or a vec2) (a vec3 in @3d files)

properties.name: global_position
properties.doc: Where it is in the world, after its parents (a vec3 in @3d files)

properties.name: global_rotation
properties.doc: Rotation in the world, after its parents (a vec3 in @3d files)

properties.name: parent
properties.doc: The parent entity, or nil. Set it to reparent (it stays where it is on screen)

properties.name: velocity
properties.doc: RigidBody.velocity, or Motion.velocity (in @3d files: RigidBody3D.velocity, a vec3)

properties.name: angular_velocity
properties.doc: RigidBody.angular_velocity (degrees / second) (in @3d files a vec3 about x, y, z)

properties.name: id
properties.doc: A number unique to the entity

properties.name: forward
properties.doc: Which way a 3D entity faces: its -z in the world (read only)

properties.name: right
properties.doc: A 3D entity's +x in the world (read only)

properties.name: up
properties.doc: A 3D entity's +y in the world (read only)

callbacks.name: start
callbacks.doc: Runs once, before the entity's first update.

callbacks.name: update
callbacks.doc: Runs every fixed step; dt is the step in seconds.

callbacks.name: on_collision
callbacks.signature: on_collision(other: entity, normal: vec2, speed: number) -> void
callbacks.doc: This collider started touching other's. In @3d files the normal is a vec3 (normal: vec3).

callbacks.name: on_trigger
callbacks.doc: other entered a trigger (this entity's or its own).

callbacks.name: draw
callbacks.doc: Runs when the scene is drawn: draw_rect(), draw_text() and the rest draw then, in the layer the script's `draw_layer` var names (0 without one). Only draw here: it doesn't run on every frame of a fast-forwarded replay.

callbacks.name: on_pause
callbacks.doc: Another scene was pushed over this one (push_scene).

callbacks.name: on_resume
callbacks.doc: This scene is the top one again (the one over it was popped).

keywords.var: Declares a variable. At the top of a file: one per entity, kept between calls.
keywords.const: Declares a variable that can't be changed once it has its value (`const MAX: int = 5`). In a class: a field only its init() can set; `static const`: one for the whole class.
keywords.struct: Declares a struct: fields and functions, used as a value (storing one stores a copy, and `==` compares the fields). `struct Point { var x: number = 0 }`, made with `Point(1, 2)`.
keywords.class: Declares a class: fields and functions, shared by reference. One parent: `class Dog : Animal { ... }`. Made with `Dog(...)`, which runs its `init()`.
keywords.public: A member anything can use (the default).
keywords.private: A member only the struct's or class's own functions can use.
keywords.protected: A member only the class and the classes that inherit from it can use.
keywords.static: A member of the class itself, not of each object: `Counter.total`, `Counter.reset()`. Every entity running the file shares it.
keywords.override: Replaces the parent class's function of the same name (same parameters and result): `override func speak() -> string`.
keywords.this: Inside a struct's or class's function: the object it runs on (`this.x`).
keywords.super: Inside a class's function: the parent's version of a function (`super.speak()`, `super.init(name)`).
keywords.unsigned: Before int or number: never below 0 (`unsigned int`, or `uint`). Checked whenever one is stored.
keywords.for: for item in list { ... }  /  for i in 10 { ... }
keywords.return: Returns from the function (with a value).
keywords.continue: Skips to the next turn of the loop.
keywords.nil: Nothing. nil, false and 0 count as false.
keywords.@strict: At the top of a file: every var, parameter and function result must have a type (`var hp: int = 3`, `var hp := 3`, `func f(a: vec2) -> bool`).
keywords.@3d: At the top of a file: the script drives a 3D entity, so self.position, rotation, scale, velocity... are vec3s, and z, forward, right and up exist. Combine with @strict.
keywords.component: Declares one of the game's own components: `component Health { var hp: int = 3 }`. Its fields need types (int, number, bool, string, vec2, vec3, color, entity, enum(a, b)); scenes save it, the editor's inspector edits it, and scripts use it as `self.Health.hp`.

types.name: number
types.doc: Any number (all numbers are floating point). `float` means the same.

types.name: int
types.doc: A whole number. Literals like `3` are ints; `/` gives a number, and `floor()` / `round()` make one whole again.

types.name: uint
types.doc: An unsigned int: a whole number that is never below 0. The same as `unsigned int`.

types.name: list
types.doc: A list. `list[number]` says what its items are.

types.name: any
types.doc: Anything: checked only when it runs.
